propositions: Three authenticated file-impact states (undeclared, paths, none) are implemented but scattered across four documentation locations without a unified author-facing contract
Public `rebar explain plan` command lacks guidance on tri-state choices, set-file-impact command, and the distinction between no repository changes and where output lives
Event schema, gate logic, and ticket model docs omit replacement/clearing semantics and the rule that docs-only or test-only work declares paths, not none
The no-file-impact plan-review criterion is advisory LLM review applying only to authenticated none declarations, but this posture is not documented in author guides

Documentation audit requires a durable semantic checklist with path:line evidence rather than grepping source or snapshot testing, and public CLI behavior must be verified through an actual command invocation test
